l: 来たな  貴様がシドか！
There you are. So you're Cid!
Welcome back, Lord Commander!
kita na kisama ga shido ka!
出迎えご苦労！
Thanks for the welcome!
Oh, I'm not staying.
demukae go kurou!
てめえの部隊だけで  この砦を落とすなんてな
Taking this fortress with nothing but your own troops...

Never were one for half measures,
were you, Benedikta?
temeeno butai dakede kono toride wo oto sunantena
ベネディクタめ  大したもんだ
Benedikta, you're really something.
These poor sods didn't know what hit them.
benedikuta me taishita monda
奴ら仲間を呼ぶ気だ！　追うぞ！
They're going to call for reinforcements! After them!
All this bloody running... After them!
yatsu ra nakama wo yobu kida! ou zo!
これで罠のつもりかよ！
And this is supposed to be a trap!
Seems they were expecting us.
korede wana notsumorikayo!
押し通る！
We're pushing through!
You don't say.
oshi touru!
この先は礼拝堂か
So the chapel's up ahead.
The only way is through the chapel...
kono saki ha reihaidou ka
それにしたって  やけに静かだ…
Even so, it's awfully quiet...
Then "great Greagor" must have plans for us...
sorenishitatte yakeni shizuka da…
ベネディクタはどこに…！
Where's Benedikta...!
She must be here somewhere...
benedikuta hadokoni…!
ここから行けるか…
So we can get through from here...
I'm running out of tower...
kokokara ike ruka…
あの女  どこへ行った…？
Where did that woman go...?
She'd better not have flown away...
ano onna dokohe itta…？
（トルガルの吠え声）
(Torgal's bark)

<speaker=Torgal>
*barks*
( torugaru no hoe koe)
この上にいるんだな…？
She's up above, then...?
Finally.
kono ueni irundana…？
（トルガルの吠え声）
(Torgal's bark)

<speaker=Torgal>
*bark*
( torugaru no hoe koe)
追い詰めたぞ…！
I've got you cornered...!
I've found you!
oitsume tazo…!
火のドミナントは俺だったのに…
The Dominant of Fire was me, and yet...
This is stupid. I'm the Dominant of Fire...
hi no dominanto ha ore dattanoni…
ガブに謝らなければ
I have to apologize to Gav.
We sent Gav on a wild goose chase...
gabu ni ayamara nakereba
こんなときにまで戦いを…
Fighting, even at a time like this...
More killing... And for what...?
konnatokinimade tatakai wo…
今のは…？
What was that...?
What now...?
ima noha…？
蛮族か！
Barbarians, is it!
A beastman!?
banzoku ka!
シドの奴  何が抜け道だ…
That Cid. What kind of shortcut is this...
Another perfect little shortcut, Cid.
shido no yatsu nani ga nukemichi da…
相変わらず魔物だらけじゃないか
It's crawling with monsters, as ever.
Straight through a nest of bloodthirsty beasts...
aikawarazu mamono darakejanaika
ガブはまだ先か…
Is Gav still further ahead...?
Can't be much further now.
gabu hamada saki ka…
またこいつか  手間のかかる…！
This one again. Always such a bother...!
Oh, come on. Let me through!
matakoitsuka tema nokakaru…!
これは…
This is...
Could I have done this?
koreha…
何てこと…
Oh no...
Could anyone?
nante koto…
あいつは真実を握ってる！
He holds the truth!
He's the only one who can tell me what happened!
aitsuha shinjitsu wo nigitsu teru!
追うんだ！
After him!
I have to know!
ou nda!
あれは  さっきと同じ仕掛けか…？
Is that the same mechanism as before...?
Another gate. Let's see if this one opens.
areha sakkito onaji shikake ka…？
ここは  《空の文明》の遺跡…？
Are these ruins of the Fallen...?
Could this place really be a Fallen ruin?
kokoha << sora no bunmei >> no iseki…？

どこの遺跡も朽ちているのに
こんなにも形が残ったままだなんて…

Ruins everywhere else have crumbled, and yet
this one still stands so intact...

You could hardly call it a ruin.
It's perfect. Like it was built yesterday.
dokono iseki mo kuchi teirunoni / konnanimo katachi ga nokotsu tamamadanante…
遺物が動くとは…！
The relic moves...!
How can these things still function?
ibutsu ga ugoku toha…!

それだけじゃないわ
この遺跡自体が まだ動いているのよ…！

That's not all.
The ruin itself is still moving...!

How can any of this? This must be
what the Fallen ruins were like before they fell.
soredakejanaiwa / kono iseki jitai ga mada ugoi teirunoyo…!
この遺物は何かしら…
What could this relic be...?
Does any of this make sense to you...?
kono ibutsu ha nanika shira…
分からない  とにかく先へ進んでみよう
I don't know. For now, let's push on ahead.
None. Let's find the hooded man and leave.
waka ranai tonikaku saki he susun demiyou
手ごわそうな奴だぞ
That one looks tough.
Looks like it can take a beating.
tegowaso una yatsu dazo
分かってる！
I know!
Then let's give it one.
waka tteru!
何だ  こいつらは…！
What are these things...!
What the hell are they!?
nanda koitsuraha…!
これも遺物だっていうの！？
You're telling me these are relics too!?
Whatever they are, I don't think they're friendly!
koremo ibutsu datteiuno!？
ジョシュアは  いつもこんなところを？
Does Joshua come to places like this all the time?
Would Joshua have had to run this gauntlet too?
joshua ha itsumokonnatokorowo？
いや  そんな話は聞いたことがない…
No. I've never heard of any such thing...
No. At least, not that I ever heard about.
iya sonna hanashi ha kii takotoganai…
ここは招かれざる者の道なんだろう…
This must be a road for the uninvited...
I imagine the Phoenix would receive a warmer welcome.
kokoha maneka rezaru mono no michi nandarou…

また動いた…
一体 どこへ…

It moved again...
Where on earth to...
Here we go again. Where will we end up this time?
mata ugoi ta… / ittai dokohe…
侵入者を出迎える罠か  あるいは――
A trap to greet intruders, or else...
Surrounded by contraptions hell-bent on murdering us, I expect.
shinnyuusha wo demukae ru wana ka aruihaaa
あの男はここまで来たんだろうか？
I wonder if that man made it this far?
Could the hooded man really have taken this path?
ano otoko hakokomade kita ndarouka？

それを知るにも
もっと奥に進んでみるしかないわね

To know that,
we've no choice but to go deeper.

We won't know until we've followed it all
the way to the end. Come on, let's keep looking.
sorewo shiru nimo / motto oku ni susun demirushikanaiwane
クライヴ  新手よ！
Clive, more of them!
Look out! There's more of them!
kuraivu arate yo!
しつこい奴らめ！
Relentless bastards!
They'll fall like the rest!
shitsukoi yatsu rame!
あれは  何かの壁画かしら…
Is that some kind of mural...?
Is that some kind of...mural?
areha nanika no hekiga kashira…
近くまで行ってみよう
Let's go closer.
It's worth a closer look, whatever it is.
chikaku made itte miyou
こいつ…今までに見たことのない魔物だ…
This one... I've never seen a monster like it.
What the hell was that thing? It wasn't like the others.
koitsu… imamade ni mita kotononai mamono da…

遺物でもない…
こんな奴がいるなんて…

And it's not even a relic...
To think something like this exists...

It would seem this place holds even more secrets
than we thought.
ibutsu demonai… / konna yatsu gairunante…
ここにも出るか…！
They come out here too...!
Look out!
kokonimo deru ka…!
どうやら行き止まりだ
Looks like a dead end.
It all seems to lead to this room.
douyara ikidomari da
クライヴ  これって…
Clive, this is...
And look what's in it.
kuraivu korette…
こっちだ  ついてこい
This way. Follow me.
Come on. This way.
kotchida tsuitekoi
警戒しておけよ
Keep your guard up.
Try to stay out of sight.
keikai shiteokeyo
ああ  分かってる
Yeah, I know.
Obviously.
aa waka tteru
やれやれ  敵さんがおそろいだ…
Good grief... the whole enemy lot's here...
Alright. Not quite empty.
yareyare teki sangaosoroida…
やっちまうか
Let's take 'em down.
Let's get this over with.
yatchimauka
さあ  とっとと片づけるぞ！
Come on, let's wrap this up fast!
I swear this passage used to be secret.
saa tottoto katazu keruzo!
あんたの抜け道はいつもこうだ
Your shortcuts always turn out like this.
Of course it did.
antano nukemichi haitsumokouda
言ったろ  刺激が必要だって！
I told you, you need a bit of excitement!
Perfect plans, Clive. Perfect plans.
itta ro shigeki ga hitsuyou datte!
あれは…？
What's that...?
The main tunnel.
areha…？
警備が厳しいな
Heavy security.
That would be my guess.
keibi ga ikameshii na
クリスタルの運搬路か
The Crystal transport route, is it?
There are sentries everywhere.
kurisutaru no unpan michi ka
抜け道はここで終わりだ
The shortcut ends here.
And all good things must come to an end.
nukemichi hakokode owari da
奴らを倒して進むぞ
We take them down and push on.
We might have a bit more company from now on.
yatsu rawo taoshi te susumu zo
このエーテルは下の層からあふれてきてるな…まさか…
This aether's welling up from the lower levels... Don't tell me...

Guard duty's a death sentence in this place.
Not that Sylvestre cares.
kono eeteru ha shitano sou karaafuretekiteruna… masaka…

思ったとおりだ…濃いエーテルが漂って
《エーテル溜まり》になってやがる…！
Just as I thought... Thick aether's drifting about, and it's turned into an aetherflood...!

Ah, breathe deep of the blessing, my friends.
Who said being a Dominant doesn't have its benefits?
omotta toorida… koi eeteru ga tadayotsu te / << eeteru tama ri >> ninatteyagaru…!
このまま下りて大丈夫なのか？
Is it safe to keep going down?
Cid, this is an aetherflood.
konomama kudari te daijoubu nanoka？
ドミナントやベアラーなら  少しの間は耐えられる
Dominants and Bearers can hold out for a little while.
There shouldn't be one here, should there? The workers couldn't survive this.
dominanto ya bearaa nara sukoshi no kan ha tae rareru
だが  あまり長居もしてられん
But we can't linger too long.
Well, it wasn't here last time, I can tell you that.
daga amari nagai moshiteraren

ここから地下採掘場だ
その先にマザークリスタルがある

From here it's the underground mines.
The Mothercrystal lies beyond.

Which means we need to be quick.
The aether won't hurt us...
kokokara chika saikutsu ba da / sono sakini mazaakurisutaru gaaru
ともかく  急ぐとしよう
Anyway, let's get a move on.

...but I'd rather not find out what it's done
to everyone else.
tomokaku isogu toshiyou
そんな…みんなアカシアになってる…！
No... They've all turned Akashic...!
The miners... The guards...
sonna… minna akashia ninatteru…!

作業員に警備兵…
こいつら 逃げる間もなかったか

Workers and guards...
These lot never even had a chance to run, did they.
Too far gone. The aether's made monsters of them.
sagyouin ni keibihei… / koitsura nige ru kan monakattaka
こうなったらもう助からん   やるぞ
There's no saving them now. Let's go.
All we can do now is put them out of their misery.
kounattaramou tasuka ran yaruzo

ノースリーチのイサベルが言っていた
ここの連中が オリフレムを捨てるという噂があると

Isabelle of Northreach said
there's a rumour these people mean to abandon Oriflamme.

Isabelle said she thought the empire might be
planning to abandon the capital. Could this be why?
noosuriichi no isaberu ga itte ita / kokono renchuu ga orifuremu wo sute rutoiu uwasa gaaruto

なるほど あの噂は本当だったのか…国のお偉方は
ここにエーテル溜まりが出たのを把握してたんだろう

I see. So that rumour was true... The country's high-ups
must have known an aetherflood had opened up here.

What? She said you could call her Isabelle?
Never mind. If ever there was a reason to
up sticks, an aetherflood would be it.
naruhodo ano uwasa ha hontou dattanoka… kuni noo i kataha / kokoni eeteru tama riga deta nowo haaku shitetandarou

連中 “アカシアの巣”のない
新たな皇都をつくる気なのかもしれん

Maybe they mean to build a new capital
with no "nest of Akashic" in it.

Fuck me... Those guards at the gate.
They weren't there to keep people out.
renchuu “ akashia no su ” nonai / arata na kouto wotsukuru kina nokamoshiren
そのための再軍備か…！
So that's what the rearmament's for...!
They were there to keep the Akashic in.
sonotameno saigunbi ka…!

この先だが…
何だこの鉄格子は…

Up ahead, though...
What's with this iron grate...

I see they replaced that wooden door
with something a little more sturdy.
kono saki daga… / nanda kono tetsugoushi ha…
面倒なもんつくりやがって…
They had to go and build something this troublesome...
As if that was going to keep us out...
mendou namontsukuriyagatte…
そろそろ  マザークリスタルだ
The Mothercrystal's not far now.
The Mothercrystal's just up ahead.
sorosoro mazaakurisutaru da
本当にこんなところから行けるの？
Can we really get in from a place like this?
Is it? I can't see a thing.
hontou nikonnatokorokara ike runo？
まあ  見てなって
Well, just you watch.
Well, unless someone's moved it.
maa mite natte
こいつらは  まさか！？
These guys... don't tell me!?
Oh no...
koitsuraha masaka!？
あのときの…！？
The ones from back then...!?
Them again.
anotokino…!？
化け物とも知り合いなのか？
You know monsters too, do you?
Is there something you two want to tell me?
bakemono tomo shiriai nanoka？
そんなんじゃない…！
It's not like that...!
Maybe later.
sonnanjanai…!

フェニックスゲートにいた魔物が
こんなところにも…

The monsters from Phoenix Gate
are here as well...

But how could those creatures from Phoenix Gate
be here in the mines?
fenikkusugeeto niita mamono ga / konnatokoronimo…
この場所と何か  関係があるのか…？
Do they have something to do with this place...?
Are the two places connected somehow?
kono basho to nanika kankei gaarunoka…？

そういえば聞いたことがある
ドレイクヘッドのクリスタル神殿には 聖域を守る番人がいると

Come to think of it, I've heard
that the Crystal shrine at Drake's Head has a guardian who protects the sanctuary.

When I was in the imperial army, soldiers assigned to the Glass Gate
would tell stories about something they called the Guardian.
souieba kii takotogaaru / doreikuheddo no kurisutaru shinden niha seiiki wo mamoru bannin gairuto

前に俺が潜り込んだときには
お目にかからなかったんだがな

When I slipped in there before,
I never ran into one, though.
Can't say I saw anything like that when I was last here. Then again, I can't say I made it this far.
mae ni ore ga moguri kon datokiniha / o meni kakaranakattandagana
とにかく慎重に
In any case, let's be careful.
Let's just be careful then.
tonikaku shinchou ni
さあて――
Right then...
We're almost there.
saateee
覚悟はいいか？
You ready?
Anyone having second thoughts?
kakugo haiika？
もちろんだ
Of course.
Not me.
mochironda
ええ  見届けるわ
Yes. I'll see it through.
We're with you to the end, Cid.
ee mitodoke ruwa
ありがとうよ
Thanks.
Then what are we waiting for?
arigatouyo
それにしても  この島を歩く日が来るとは
Still, to think the day would come when I'd walk this island.
I always imagined when I came here, it would be to reclaim it.
sorenishitemo kono shima wo aruku nichi ga kuru toha
昔はロザリアの聖地だった
It was holy ground of Rosaria, once.
It used to belong to Rosaria, didn't it?
mukashi ha rozaria no seichi datta
ずいぶん前に鉄王国に支配されたがな
Though the Iron Kingdom took it long ago.
Once. Though it's been in the Ironblood's clutches for far too long.
zuibun mae ni tetsu oukoku ni shihai saretagana

あなたに会うまで 私はずっとここにいたの
だから 少しは案内できると思う

I was here all along, until I met you.
So I can show you around a little, I think.
As was I. For thirteen years, this rock was my home. I know its secrets only too well.
anatani au made watashi hazuttokokoniitano / dakara sukoshi ha annai dekiruto omou

この道は エーテル溜まりができてから
警備もいないわ

Since the aetherflood formed, this road
has had no guards either.
This path was abandoned after an aetherflood. They don't guard it anymore.
kono michi ha eeteru tama rigadekitekara / keibi moinaiwa
潜入にはもってこいか
Ideal for slipping in, is it?
The perfect little shortcut.
sennyuu nihamottekoika
アカシアが…！
Akashic...!
They're all Akashic!
akashia ga…!

私がいたときより エーテル溜まりが広がってる…！
厄介だわ 早く倒しましょう！

The aetherflood has spread further than when I was here...!
How troublesome. Let's finish them quickly!

The aetherflood must have spread—it was never as bad as
this before. And the only way past them...is through them!
watashi gaitatokiyori eeteru tama riga hiroga tteru…! / yakkai dawa hayaku taoshi mashou!
今のは一体…
What in the world was that...?
Was that an earthquake?
ima noha ittai…

ここは元々 地揺れが多いの
心配ないわ

This place has always had frequent tremors.
There's nothing to worry about.
They happen all the time. That wasn't even a bad one. It's nothing to worry about.
kokoha motomoto chi yure ga ooi no / shinpai naiwa

この先に庭園があったはず
そこから山の中に

There should be a garden up ahead.
From there, into the mountain.

The old arboretum is just up ahead.
We'll enter the caves from there.
kono sakini teien gaattahazu / sokokara yama no nakani
ジル  片づけるぞ！
Jill, let's clear them out!
Just like old times.
jiru katazu keruzo!
やけに暑いな…
It's awfully hot...
It's like a furnace in here...
yakeni atsui na…
熱で溶けた岩が流れ続けているから
The rock melted by the heat keeps flowing.
We're inside the volcano. You get used to the heat.
netsu de toke ta iwa ga nagare tsuzuke teirukara
でも前より激しくなってる…
But it's fiercer than before...
Though I don't remember it being quite this hot...
demo mae yori hageshiku natteru…
これは  また地揺れが…
The tremors again, is it...
Was that one cause for concern?
koreha mata chi yure ga…

さっきより大きくなってる…
何か変ね…

They're stronger than a moment ago...
Something's wrong...
It was. And they're getting bigger. Something's wrong.
sakkiyori ookiku natteru… / nanika henne…
くっ  これじゃ進めないぞ…！
Ngh! We can't go on like this...!
Fuck. Is there no other way across?
kutsu koreja susume naizo…!
ドレイクブレスか…
So that's Drake's Breath...
Drake's Breath...
doreikuburesu ka…
神殿が近いわ
The shrine is close.
We're nearly at the Oratory.
shinden ga chikai wa
ここは崩れてるわね…
It's collapsed here...
Well, we aren't going this way.
kokoha kuzure teruwane…
ほかを探してみよう
Let's try somewhere else.
Let's look for another path.
hokawo sagashi temiyou
また魔物か！
More monsters!
They don't look too tough.
mata mamono ka!
いくら何でも数が多すぎる  気をつけて
This is too many, even for that. Be careful.
Perhaps not alone, but in numbers like these...
ikura nande mo kazu ga oosu giru kiwo tsukete
何だこいつは！
What is this thing!
What the hell is that!?
nanda koitsuha!
こんな魔物  初めて見る！
I've never seen a monster like this!
I have absolutely no idea...
konna mamono hajimete miru!
俺たちを逃がす気はないようだな…！
It doesn't seem inclined to let us get away...!
Well, whatever it is, I don't think it's friendly!
ore tachiwo niga su kiha naiyoudana…!
神殿に勤める従者たちの居住区よ
This is the living quarters for the servants who work at the temple.

We'll enter the Comraich
by the handmaidens' living quarters.
shinden ni tsutome ru juusha tachino kyojuuku yo
ここから人が多くなるわ
There will be more people from here on.
It was always a hive of activity.
kokokara nin ga ooku naruwa
見つかって騒ぎにならなければいいが…
I hope we aren't spotted and don't set off a commotion...
Sounds like we'll have a hard time staying out of sight.
mitsu katte sawagi ninaranakerebaiiga…
ええ  でもあの人に会えれば  切り抜けられるはず…
Yes. But if we can meet that person, we should be able to get through...

We won't have to. There's someone there
I should very much like to see.
ee demoano nin ni ae reba kirinuke rareruhazu…
行きましょう！
Let's go!
Come on, Clive.
iki mashou!
神殿まで突っ切る！
We push straight through to the temple!
We're nearly at the Comraich.
shinden made tsukkiru!
ああ！
Right!
Alright.
aa!
鉄王国の警備兵か！
Iron Kingdom guards!
Here's our welcoming party!
tetsu oukoku no keibihei ka!
邪魔する奴は容赦しない！
I'll show no mercy to anyone who stands in our way!
I've had enough of their hospitality!
jama suru yatsu ha yousha shinai!
警備が手厚い…！
They're guarding it heavily...!
How many of them are there!?
keibi ga teatsui…!
どきなさい！
Out of my way!
Too many!
dokinasai!
大司祭イムラン  あの男は――
High Priest Imreann... that man is...
Clive, there's something I need you to know.
taishi matsuri imuran ano otoko haaa
教えを隠れ蓑に外道の限りを尽くした…！
He hid behind the teachings and committed every kind of outrage...!
I saw the Patriarch do things no one should have to see.
oshie wo kakure mino ni gaidou no kagiri wo tsukushi ta…!
奴だけは  必ず私がこの手で！
Him alone... I will be the one to do it with my own hands!
And so I swore that he would die by my hand.
yatsu dakeha kanarazu watashi gakono tede!

ああ 分かってる
君の過去に決着をつけるんだ

Yeah, I know.
You're going to settle your past.
I understand. I faced my demons—and you must face yours.
aa waka tteru / kun no kako ni ketchaku wotsukerunda
残すはこれだけ！　このまま押し切る！
